subject: Aligning demo timing with finance replan & travel conflicts
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@lambdahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo week options (Lambda Health)

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday — Rajiv (our Head of Data) and I are eager to see Redwood in action. We have a couple of timing constraints on our side coming up: our finance leadership is doing an FY replan the week of July 20–24 and Rajiv will be traveling the week of July 19 (back-to-back on-site reviews).

Proposed windows that could work from our side:
- Tue 21 Jul: any time before 3pm PT
- Thu 23 Jul: after 11am PT
- Mon 27 Jul: open all day

If it helps, our preference is to see a focused 45-minute product demo + 15-minute pricing/next-steps slot. I attached a one-pager agenda and will send a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

Context: we’re trying to align demo timing with our finance committee so decisioning (and any budget ask) lands right after their replan. If your team has constraints around the 21/23 dates, Monday 27 would also be fine.

Thanks — Emily

--
Emily Chen
Director of Product & Data
Lambda Health
Attachments: lambda_proposed_agenda_v1.pdf (1 page)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@lambdahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo week options (Lambda Health)

Hi Emily — great to hear, thanks for the calendar windows and the agenda. Quick note from our side: Markus (cc’d) and I will run the product portion; Kar (cc’d) should be available for pricing/contract follow-up. Two things I want to flag so we can align expectations before we lock a time:

1) Markus is tied up at an on-site with an integration partner on Tue 21 morning and will be flying that afternoon — he’s back late on Wed.
2) We’ve seen customers prefer scheduling the demo after their internal replan if the replan materially affects scope/priorities; if your finance committee is likely to shift priorities during the 20–24 replan, Monday 27 might reduce the need to re-run the demo for a different audience.

Possible options from our side:
- Thu 23 Jul 1:00–2:00pm PT (product + pricing wrap) — Markus can join remotely for the product segment before his evening travel.
- Mon 27 Jul 11:00–12:00pm PT — safest option to include finance leadership after their replan.

If you think procurement/CFO will be present, we can extend to a full hour. Also added the HubSpot deal link below so everyone has the record.

Olga

--

Emily — thanks for the agenda, looks solid. I’m on the partner on-site on Tue 21 as Olga mentioned; I can make Thu 23 1–2pm PT but will be traveling that evening so prefer a clean handoff to Karthik for pricing/contract details.

If you expect CFO/procurement presence and want a single meeting for product + procurement questions, let’s do Mon 27 Jul 11–12pm PT. I want to ensure we have the right artifacts ready if procurement joins (SLA overview, data residency note, standard MSA outline). Karthik — can you prepare a short pricing play with the two options (hosted vs dedicated) and a pointer to the procurement pack?

Markus

Thanks all — quick update from Rajiv and me after a sync with finance: the replan is expected to wrap by COB Fri 24, and the CFO indicated she could join a meeting on Mon 27 if schedules allow. Given that, let’s lock Mon 27 Jul 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET (60 minutes) to include product + procurement questions. I’ll send a calendar invite and add the CFO, procurement lead, and Rajiv.

We’ll aim to review the proposed agenda during the first 30 minutes and reserve the last 30 for pricing and procurement items. I also attached a stub calendar invite. If you have an MSA/standard T&Cs excerpt you can share ahead of time, that would be helpful for procurement — otherwise we’ll go over high-level terms in the meeting.
